limitations: Dense-grid optima and the robust multiplier are selected after inspecting E83-derived results. They are planning recommendations for a future independent pilot, not valid full-alpha choices for E83.
The grid is finite. Plateau bounds describe tested multipliers and do not prove a continuous optimum.
Projected future successes retain E83 rates and round to integer counts; they are planning sensitivity, not new measured paths.
The audit is local statistical analysis and is not new GPU evidence.
model: Evaluate 21 fixed full-alpha Stouffer future-stage multipliers. Each candidate is individually valid only if preregistered before the pilot. Dense-grid optima and the robust single multiplier are planning results for a future independent pilot, not permission to retune the existing E83 pilot.
